title: THE ROAD
location: L08 · SCHOOL BUS INTERIOR → L09 · MOUNTAIN ROADS
tod: 06:00 → 10:30 · dawn to late morning, altitude rising
logline: The journey out of the ordinary world, told entirely as landscape. The city drains out of the frame and the mountains take it over.
grade: Cold blue dawn in the city, warming to clean high-altitude daylight. Reduce haze as altitude increases — the air is literally getting clearer.

narration.hi: सुबह छह बजे बस चली। शहर धीरे-धीरे पीछे छूटता गया, और खिड़की के बाहर सड़कें पहाड़ों में बदल गईं।
narration.en: The bus left at six. The city fell away behind us, and outside the window the roads turned into mountains.

narration.hi: मीरा बस में पीछे की सीट पर बैठी थी। कभी-कभी वो बाहर देखती... और कभी-कभी मेरी तरफ़।
narration.en: Meera was sitting at the back of the bus. Sometimes she looked outside… and sometimes she looked at me.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.40 m from the school gate, bus front filling frame-right
shots.move: Static. Students load; breath fog visible in the cold.
shots.action: Bags into the hold, a queue that isn't a queue, Ishaan and Kabir near the door.
shots.env: L04 school gate at dawn, the bus: cream-and-navy school coach, fleet number on the front, no readable text required.
shots.light: Blue hour, 8000K, streetlights still on and warm against it.
shots.vfx: Breath vapour, engine exhaust thin in the cold. Both must be subtle.
shots.cont: BUS LOCK: cream body, navy stripe, school crest on the door, 3+2 seating. Same bus in S10-07 and S11-02 at long range.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.55 m, at the bus door, 3/4
shots.move: Static; Kabir climbs in and turns back to say something to Ishaan.
shots.action: Kabir puts a foot on the step, then leans out and mimes something ridiculous to Ishaan, who pushes him the rest of the way up.
shots.env: Bus doorway, driver's silhouette, a hand rail.
shots.light: Warm interior lamp from inside the coach vs cold blue dawn outside — the characters are lit by the doorway.
shots.cont: Bus interior has warm tungsten strip lighting — this is important for S10-03's colour.

shots.cam: Interior of the bus, height 1.35 m from the seat in front, looking back at their seats
shots.move: Static with bus vibration — a 1-px vertical judder, no more.
shots.action: Kabir claims the window, sees Ishaan's face, sighs theatrically, and swaps seats. Ishaan grins and takes the window.
shots.expr: Kabir's long-suffering generosity; Ishaan's unearned victory.
shots.env: L08 bus interior: rexine seats, overhead luggage rack, curtained windows, driver's mirror at the far end.
shots.light: Warm strip light + cold window light on Ishaan's face. Two-temperature again, but now it's on a moving vehicle.
shots.vfx: Dust in the strip light; light flicker from passing trees on a 3-frame rhythm.
shots.vo: Line 1 ends at 24:30; the rest of the ride is nearly wordless.
shots.cont: PROPOSED (non-canon): the seat swap. Pure character comedy, no plot.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.35 m, three rows back, framed past seat backs
shots.move: Static; gentle sway synced to the bus.
shots.action: She sits alone at the back-left, cheek against the window frame, watching the landscape. She turns her head slightly forward — not quite to camera.
shots.expr: Calm, unreadable, faintly sad. The first time we see her unperformed.
shots.env: Bus back rows, empty seat beside her, the window as a bright plane.
shots.light: Cold daylight on her face, warm strip light in the ceiling above — half warm, half cold on the same cheek.
shots.vo: Silence. Do not narrate this shot.
shots.cont: She must be visually separated from the boys here — the geography of the bus is a diagram of the emotional plot.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 2.10 m, rigged to a vehicle tracking the bus through the city
shots.move: Parallel tracking, 40 km/h matching; the bus in the right third.
shots.action: City edge: flyovers, shuttered shops, a tea stall, then a widening road.
shots.env: L09 city outskirts at dawn: low buildings, wires, a broken footpath, one cow.
shots.light: Flat blue-grey morning, sodium streetlights dying out one by one.
shots.vfx: Motion blur limited to the foreground only.
shots.cont: The cow is a single-frame background gag — keep it, it's a real Indian road.

shots.cam: Drone, 120 m, tracking the bus from the front-left, mountains behind
shots.move: Slow forward tracking with a 10° tilt up to reveal the ridge line.
shots.action: The bus threads a switchback. Mist in the valley below. Pine forest on both sides.
shots.env: L09 mountain road: two-lane tarmac, stone parapet, hairpin bends, a valley of cloud.
shots.light: High-altitude morning: hard sun, crisp shadows, cool blue in the shadowed valley.
shots.vfx: Thin cloud wisps; atmospheric perspective layered in three depths.
shots.vo: Line 2 at 26:04 — the narration arrives exactly when the mountains do.
shots.cont: GEOGRAPHY: the observatory ridge is visible on the horizon from this shot onwards (a small white dome, frame-left). Planted here, paid off in S11-01.

shots.cam: Exterior, ground level on a far ridge, telephoto compression of the road and the bus
shots.move: Static. The bus is a tiny object crossing the frame in 14 s.
shots.action: The bus crawls along a switchback; the scale of the terrain reduces it to a beetle.
shots.env: Vast ridge landscape, terraced fields far below, snow line just visible at the top of frame.
shots.light: Sun on the ridge, shadow in the valley; the bus is a bright fleck.
shots.vfx: Haze layer between camera and subject.
shots.vo: Line 2 ends on this shot, on the smallness of them.
shots.cont: Scale rule: this is the largest frame in the episode until S13-01. Save the epic for the Core.
